overview: > A lightweight Gemma 4 software engineering agent designed for repository-level issue resolution. The notebook performs dataset and repository analysis, identifies relevant files and code symbols, evaluates repository structure and available agent tools, and builds an analyzer-plus-coder workflow. It uses targeted code localization, structured prompts, constrained sampling, patch validation, compilation checks, and strict submission-bundle validation. The final agent configuration, prompts, sub-agent setup, and sampling parameters are packaged into a reproducible `submission.zip` artifact.
usage:
```text
Cell 1 builds and validates the Gemma 4 SWE agent bundle and saves it as ${submission.zip}. Cell 2 reloads ${submission.zip}, verifies its integrity using the stored SHA-256 checksum, and confirms the final submission contents.
```

> **Run Cell 1 to build and save `${submission.zip}`. Then run Cell 2 to reload, verify, and inspect the final agent submission.**
